details.specs: Dual relay: humidify + dehumidify outputs, 1% RH resolution, 110V switched outlets
details.preferredBrands: Inkbird IHC-200, Govee Smart Humidity Controller
details.alternatives: Single-relay humidistat, Smart plug + humidity sensor

maintenance.yearly: Replace sensor probe if reading drift

details.notes: Controls misting system (humidify relay) and island fan (dehumidify relay). Target island RH: 70-80%.
